hanziSentence: 合同的所有条件都已经确定。
pinyinSentence: hé tóng de suǒ yǒu tiáo jiàn dōu yǐjīng què dìng.
meaningSentence: All the contract terms have been confirmed.

hanziSentence: 请清楚地说明你的要求。
pinyinSentence: qǐng qīng chǔ de shuō míng nǐ de yāo qiú.

hanziSentence: 我们必须遵守合同条款。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men bìxū zūn shǒu hé tóng tiáo kuǎn.
meaningSentence: We must comply with the contract terms.

hanziSentence: 这次会议的时间表很紧张。
pinyinSentence: zhè cì huì yì de shí jiān biǎo hěn jǐn zhāng.
meaningSentence: The schedule for this meeting is very tight.

hanziSentence: 我们可以在会议中讨论这个问题。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men kě yǐ zài huì yì zhōng tǎo lùn zhè ge wèn tí.
meaningSentence: We can discuss this issue during the meeting.

hanziSentence: 我们希望你可以接受这个挑战。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men xī wàng nǐ kě yǐ jiē shòu zhè ge tiào zhàn.
meaningSentence: We hope you can accept this challenge.
